author: Medvedev
annotations: Board nose/tail endpoints manually estimated from original 1024x576 source pixels; not MediaPipe output.
Metric jump height and pitch are approximate perspective-calibrated estimates, not multi-camera measurements.
Source begins at an already compressed crouch. No missing anticipation frames are invented.
World body33 is hip-relative; it cannot supply the board/root trajectory.
Canonical regular is mirrored across X with anatomical left/right exchange from the captured goofy stance.
Foot/deck contact and front-foot side/instep roll are explicit retarget constraints, not measured finger/sole capture.
Retarget foot headings are constrained to the anatomical forward hemisphere: 70 percent hip-frame direction, 30 percent captured heel/toe direction.
Knee bend poles retain the captured lateral direction within the anatomical forward hemisphere; monocular depth is not treated as authoritative knee anatomy.
The 58-degree front-foot roll envelope is an authored side/instep contact correction during source frames 30 through 39, not measured sole orientation.
